design: round33 exact scenario generator, 45 initial labels for reversal, same latent path and initial Ridge per seed; reversal common decision ticks 60–143, other cases all common observed
primary_family: 17 contrasts: robust minus original in 3 anomalies and 2 reversals; original minus each baseline in 4 original_comparison_cases
interval: seed-paired t interval using critical 4.0, df23, conservative Bonferroni family 17; secondary pointwise t critical 2.06865761; censor event clock at 89 ticks
classification: upper below -0.02 improve; lower above +0.02 degrade; full interval within [-0.02,+0.02] within_margin; otherwise inconclusive
decision: keep references; robust research requires >=2 anomaly improvements and both reversal intervals rule out +0.02 harm; if >=2 anomalies improve without clearing guard, diagnostic only; if no anomaly improves and >=1 reversal degrades, deprioritize, else inconclusive. Original research requires beating all three baselines by margin in both reversals and ruling out +0.02 harm vs fixed in stable_signal and cluster; if not and any measured cluster or reversal contrast degrades, deprioritize, else inconclusive.
retry: exclusive lock and append-only local seed reservations before use; failed launches retain evidence and affected seeds cannot be reused as fresh; revisions require a new preregistration and unused seeds
